Flatten results into one row per reportable estimate

Source: R/rows.R
cr_rows.Rd

The common format behind cr_report(), cr_ground_truth(), cr_verify(), and cr_expect(). Works for clean_regress() results and for simple tests (cr_ttest(), cr_chisq(), cr_anova(), cr_cor()).

Usage

cr_rows(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A clean_results or cr_tests object.

...

Unused.

Value

A data frame.
